from pathlib import Path
import ctypes as c,json,struct,sys
from ctypes import wintypes as w
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.work/vm-windows-variable-investigation-20261115'
class Symbol(c.Structure):
 _fields_=[('SizeOfStruct',w.ULONG),('TypeIndex',w.ULONG),('Reserved',c.c_ulonglong*2),('Index',w.ULONG),('Size',w.ULONG),('ModBase',c.c_ulonglong),('Flags',w.ULONG),('Value',c.c_ulonglong),('Address',c.c_ulonglong),('Register',w.ULONG),('Scope',w.ULONG),('Tag',w.ULONG),('NameLen',w.ULONG),('MaxNameLen',w.ULONG),('Name',c.c_char*1)]
api=c.WinDLL('dbghelp',use_last_error=True);handle=c.c_void_p(1)
api.SymSetOptions.argtypes=[w.DWORD];api.SymSetOptions.restype=w.DWORD;api.SymSetOptions(0x4|0x200|0x400|0x1000|0x80000|0x02000000)
api.SymInitialize.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,c.c_char_p,w.BOOL];api.SymInitialize.restype=w.BOOL
api.SymCleanup.argtypes=[w.HANDLE];api.SymCleanup.restype=w.BOOL
api.SymLoadModuleEx.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,w.HANDLE,c.c_char_p,c.c_char_p,c.c_ulonglong,w.DWORD,c.c_void_p,w.DWORD];api.SymLoadModuleEx.restype=c.c_ulonglong
callback=c.WINFUNCTYPE(w.BOOL,c.POINTER(Symbol),w.ULONG,c.c_void_p)
api.SymEnumSymbols.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,c.c_ulonglong,c.c_char_p,callback,c.c_void_p];api.SymEnumSymbols.restype=w.BOOL
records={}
for label in ('baseline','candidate'):
 exe=out/(label+'-symbols/bin/sigma.exe')
 if not exe.exists():continue
 data=exe.read_bytes();pe=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,0x3c)[0];imagebase=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,pe+24+24)[0]
 assert api.SymInitialize(handle,str(exe.parent).encode(),False),c.get_last_error()
 try:
  base=api.SymLoadModuleEx(handle,None,str(exe).encode(),None,imagebase,0,None,0);assert base,c.get_last_error();symbols=[]
  @callback
  def receive(ptr,size,context):
   s=ptr.contents;name=c.string_at(c.addressof(s)+Symbol.Name.offset,s.NameLen).decode('utf8',errors='replace')
   symbols.append({'name':name,'address':hex(s.Address),'rva':hex(s.Address-base),'bytes':s.Size,'tag':s.Tag});return True
  assert api.SymEnumSymbols(handle,base,b'*runOperationsLoop*',receive,None),c.get_last_error()
  records[label]={'imagebase':hex(imagebase),'symbols':symbols};print(label,symbols,flush=True)
 finally:api.SymCleanup(handle)
(out/'symbols.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2)+'\n')
